svg.title: Which parts go on which side of a double-sided board
svg.desc: Drawn to scale, side view. A 1.6 mm board on its second pass through the reflow oven. The side built second faces up and carries the heavy parts: a large inductor and a USB connector whose pegs go through the board. The side built first hangs underneath and carries only small, light parts: a QFN chip and small resistors and capacitors, held on by the surface tension of the melted solder.

g.text: Second side, built last (facing up in the oven)
First side, built first (hanging upside down)
Heavy parts on the second side
Parts with pegs through the board
All on the second side, together
Pegs poke out the first side
So the first side is printed before they're fitted
Drawn to scale. Board 1.6 mm thick.
Rule of thumb for a part on the first side: weight ÷ total pad area ≤ about 30 g/in² (0.047 g/mm²),
